templates.dataset_list:
select
  dataset.id as dataset,
  dataset.stream_id as stream,
  dataset.path as display_name,
  to_char(dataset.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:ssOF') as created_at,
  timestamp_start,
  timestamp_stop,
  n_datapoints as datapoints,
  n_signals as nsignals,
  dataset.metadata,
  (
    datastream.type = 'realtime'
    AND timestamp_stop + (5 * 60 * (1e9::BIGINT)) >= extract(epoch from now()) * 1e9
  )
  as realtime,
  datastream.name as stream_name,
  datastream.datapool,
  datastream.layer_shifts -> 0 :: int as layer_shift
from "mdb_{{datapool}}_dataset" dataset
left join "_mdb"."mdb_datastream" datastream
  on stream_id = datastream.id
templates.signal_list:
WITH signal AS (
  SELECT
    signal_id as id,
    name,
    unit,
    description,
    storage_status,
    count,
    count_value,
    count_text,
    metadata || stats AS metadata,
    coalesce((stats->>'frequency')::float,
             CASE
                WHEN count > 1 THEN (count - 1) * 1e9 / (GREATEST(time_max - time_min, 1))
                ELSE NULL
             END
            ) as frequency
  FROM "mdb_{{datapool}}_signal"
  WHERE dataset_id = {{ dataset.dataset }}
  {%- if signal_filters %}
  AND name IN ({% for signal in signal_filters %}{{ signal.name | sql_literal}}{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %})
  {%- endif %}
)
(
  SELECT
    signal.*,
    name AS name,
    'number' as datatype
  FROM signal
    where (count_text = 0 and count_value >= 0)
      or (count_text IS NULL and count_value IS NULL)
)
UNION
(
  SELECT
    signal.*,
    name AS name,
    'text' as datatype
  FROM signal
    where (count_text > 0 and count_value = 0)
)
UNION
(
  SELECT
    signal.*,
    name || '.raw' AS name,
    'number' AS datatype
  FROM signal
  WHERE (count_text > 0 and count_value  > 0)
)
UNION
(
  SELECT
    signal.*,
    name AS name,
    'text' AS datatype
  FROM signal
  WHERE (count_text > 0 and count_value > 0)
)
